newsitem.title: UK: Man Utd down again as poor run continues.
newsitem.headline: Man Utd down again as poor run continues.

text.p: Shares in English football league champions Manchester United slipped again on Thursday after last nights 1-0 European Cup Champion's League defeat by Turkey's Fenerbahce, traders said.
Last night's loss which comes on the back of successsive 5-0 and 6-3 losses in the English league pushed shares in the club 25-1/2p lower to 507-1/2p.
Manchester United must now take four points from its remaining two games to be sure of qualifying for the lucrative quarter finals of the competition.
The shares ran up 20p yesterday in anticipation of the win that would have ensured qualification, traders said.
The shares have slipped 32p since the recent poor run of form began with defeat by Newcastle United on October 20.
